features.name: Project Setup
features.description: Scaffold Next.js (React, TypeScript, Tailwind) frontend and FastAPI backend. Verify both run locally. Set up SQLite database connection.

features.name: Vocabulary Database Seeding
features.description: Parse word-bank/P4_Top200_MOE_Aligned_Vocabulary.txt and seed all 200 words into SQLite. Each word should store: word, part of speech, category, meaning, synonym, example sentence.

features.name: Claude API Integration
features.description: Set up Claude API client in FastAPI. Create a service that accepts a word and context, and returns generated quiz content (MCQ, sentence, conversation) following the rules in LEARNING_STRATEGY.md.

features.name: Quiz Round 1 — MCQ
features.description: Generate 10 MCQs from today's word set via Claude API. Each question has 4 answer choices. If correct: positive feedback, next question. If incorrect: immediately show meaning, pronunciation, and example sentence. Record wrong words to wrong-words-log with date and wrong count.

features.name: Review 1 — Word Display
features.description: After Round 1, collect all incorrect words. For each word display: word, meaning, example sentence. Xiaowei acknowledges each before moving on.

features.name: Quiz Round 2 — MCQ (Wrong Words Only)
features.description: Take all wrong words from Round 1. If fewer than 5 wrong words from Round 1, top up with most recently wrong words from wrong-words-log (max 3 top-up words). Use completely different sentences from Round 1. Never repeat a previous question.

features.name: Review 2 — Explain + Sentence Writing
features.description: After Round 2, for each still-incorrect word: explain again (meaning, pronunciation, example), then ask Xiaowei to write one simple sentence using the word.

features.name: Quiz Round 3 — Conversation Format
features.description: Take all wrong words from Round 2. If fewer than 5 wrong words from Round 2, top up with most recently wrong words from wrong-words-log (excluding Round 2 words, max 3 top-up words). Generate new context via Claude API. Present as a short conversation.

features.name: Scoring System
features.description: Implement scoring: +5 points for each correct answer, +0 for incorrect. Display current score in the top-right corner of the interface. Update score immediately after every question. Persist score per session in SQLite.

features.name: Session Summary
features.description: After Round 3, display full day summary: total score across all 3 rounds, words mastered, words to revisit. Show encouraging message. Session must complete within 15 minutes.

features.name: Wrong Words Log
features.description: After all 3 rounds complete, update SQLite wrong-words-log for every word answered incorrectly during the session. Each entry stores: word, date last wrong (YYYY-MM-DD), cumulative wrong count. Used by Round 2 and Round 3 to top up to max 3 questions.

features.name: Progress Persistence
features.description: Save session state to SQLite after each round so Xiaowei can resume if interrupted. Track which round is active, which words are correct/incorrect per round.

features.name: Adaptive Word Scheduling
features.description: Track word performance across sessions. Reduce frequency for words Xiaowei repeatedly masters. Schedule additional review for words he repeatedly struggles with, using new contexts each time.
